description: The public business page of a business: the About section, the theme and the custom contact values. A business has exactly one page. Business details (name, photo, phone, address) and the actions and links of the page are separate resources.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the business page (e.g., "k2xw9q4m7zt1h8ba").

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns the page. A business has exactly one page (e.g., "ea0tpkm5j3q86uaa").

about_title.description: Title of the About section, up to 150 characters (e.g., "About our studio" or null).

about_summary.description: Short About text shown on the main page, up to 500 characters (e.g., "A family-run yoga studio in Austin." or null).

about_body.description:
Full About text as HTML, shown on the About page. The server removes tags and attributes that are not on its allowlist before it stores the value (e.g., "

We opened in 2015.

" or null).

about_image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the About image (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/about.jpg" or null).

cover_image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the cover image behind the page header (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/cover.jpg" or null).

background_color.description: Page background colour as a 6-digit hex value. It shows when the page has no cover image and while the cover image loads (e.g., "#1f3a5f" or null).

action_background_color.description: Default background colour of the action buttons, as a 6-digit hex value (e.g., "#0c315e" or null).

action_text_color.description: Default text colour of the action buttons, as a 6-digit hex value (e.g., "#ffffff" or null).

phone_display.description: Which phone number the page shows. **business**: the phone number of the business. **custom**: the value of custom_phone. Whether a phone number is shown at all is a business setting, not part of this entity (e.g., "business", "custom").

custom_phone.description: Phone number shown when phone_display is "custom" (e.g., "+1 512 555 0100" or null).

email_display.description: Which email address the page shows. **business**: the email address of the business. **custom**: the value of custom_email (e.g., "business", "custom").

custom_email.description: Email address shown when email_display is "custom" (e.g., "hello@example.com" or null).

address_display.description: Which address the page shows. **business**: the address of the business. **custom**: the value of custom_address (e.g., "business", "custom").

custom_address.description: Address shown when address_display is "custom" (e.g., "12 Main St, Austin, TX" or null).

location_city.description: City in the location line under the business name (e.g., "Austin" or null).

location_state.description: State or region in the location line under the business name (e.g., "TX" or null).

recommend_enabled.description: Whether the page shows the Recommend box with share links (e.g., true, false).

reviews_widget_enabled.description: Whether the page shows the reviews widget when the business has reviews publishing (e.g., true, false).

copied_from_core_at.description: Time when the page settings were copied from the legacy LiveSite settings. Null when the page was created with default settings (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z" or null).

created_at.description: Time when the page was created (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").

updated_at.description: Time of the last change. Send this value back in an update to detect a conflicting change (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").

example.about_summary: A family-run yoga studio in Austin.
